name: Daily hassles (HS)
definition: Daily hassles scale (DH) [Sum of hassles and their severity in the past month, 0–354]

name: Rumination (CERQ-R)
definition: Cognitive emotion regulation questionnaire – rumination subscale (CERQ-R) [4–20]

name: Perceived social support (MSPSS)
definition: Multi-dimensional scale of perceived social support (MSPSS) [1–7]

name: Physical inactivity (SBQ)
definition: Sedentary behavior questionnaire (SBQ) [Hours of sitting in a typical week]

name: Smoking (SMQ)
definition: Substance Matrix Mate-Q (SMQ) [number of cigarettes in the past 30 days]

name: Prosocial behavior (PGG)
definition: Public goods game (PGG) [unconditional contribution to a common project, 0–5 euro]
